title: Two Weathers
summary: Start: enter Two Weathers. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Weather Shepherd. Do: come within 320 meters of the Weather Shepherd. The shepherd walks the terminator pocket. Ember kale wants the hot face. Ghost gourd wants the cold. Finish: after the shepherd is met, come inside Hot Face's shell. The Charter writes standing. The pocket is the claim slot. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
